long_biography.plain_text:
ES&H grew from a South Louisiana emergency-response company into a multi-unit industrial-services group under Boucvalt. He established Cenac Environmental Services in 1993 and developed it into ES&H. Specialist units followed for emergency response, plant turnarounds, safety, consulting and oilfield labour. This structure enabled the group to undertake routine compliance assignments alongside large-scale spill and disaster work.

Boucvalt oversees environmental cleanup, hazmat response and related industrial services across the United States. Other companies have extended his activities into oilfield labour consulting and property investment. His central role, however, remains founder and president of ES&H.
